g.text: Solid points pool all 24 trials; faint markers show four six-trial realizations. Two graphs × two sampling seeds; repetitions reuse each realization.
All cases, controls, losses and trial ranges remain. No control normalization or historical pooling. Ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
Lines connect tested endpoints without threshold interpolation. All 0 flagged calls retained. Both variants may follow different private sampling paths.
